[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended Microsoft Excel templates for inventory management and collection tracking.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested specialized collectible tracking tools: Collectify (free, web-based), Collectorz.com (paid subscription), and Trello (visual project management tool).
